verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented end-to-end latency figures, benchmarks, or latency-tuning guidance for the Voice Agent API. The barge-in claim that the agent will "stop instantly" is a qualitative behavior claim, not latency numbers or tuning guidance. Regional endpoints and the single-WebSocket architecture are adjacent features, not documented speed data.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
